name: Brigade Avalon
location: Sy.No 23/1A, Whitefield Village, K.R. Pura Hobli, Bengaluru East
overview: Brigade Avalon is a boutique development of 206 homes across 3 towers (2 Basement + Ground + 15 floors) on 4 acres 14 guntas in Whitefield. Homes are offered in 3.5 and 4 BHK layouts, backed by a full-scale clubhouse with a temperature-controlled swimming pool, golf simulator and business centre.
highlights: 206 exclusive homes across 3 towers on 4 acres 14 guntas
3.5 and 4 BHK layouts with study, powder room and maid's room options
Clubhouse with golf simulator, squash court, mini theatre and business centre
Temperature-controlled swimming pool and party terrace
Interconnected lobby design for a cohesive community

items: Engineered marble in living/dining/family/foyer and other bedrooms
Engineered wood in master bedroom
Engineered marble in kitchen
Wood-finish outdoor flooring on balcony deck
Matt-finish vitrified tiles in powder room, washrooms, maid's room and utility
Provision for modular kitchen (no counter or sink provided)
Plumbing/electrical provision for water purifier, refrigerator, microwave, washing machine and dishwasher
Hot & cold mixer with long body bib cock; sink provision in kitchen and utility
CP fittings: Grohe/Hansgrohe or equivalent
Sanitary fixtures: Grohe/Hansgrohe/Duravit or equivalent
Master washroom: imported marble/granite counter with wash basin, glass partition shower with rain shower
Maid's washroom: Jaquar or equivalent pedestal wash basin
Main entry: teak wood frame with designer shutter, veneer with PU/melamine polish and digital lock
Bedroom doors: pre-engineered frames, veneer finished in melamine polish
Balcony door: 3-track aluminium powder-coated full-height sliding door with bug screen
Aluminium/UPVC windows with SGU and bug screen
VRV system — Daikin/Samsung/Mitsubishi or equivalent
Heat pump for hot water — AO Smith/V-Guard/Jaquar/Racold or equivalent
Power supply: 9 kW for 3 BHK+Study, 12 kW for 4 BHK+Maid
Modular switches: Legrand/Schneider or equivalent
IoT-based smart switches and smart door lock
100% DG backup for apartments (chargeable); 100% DG backup for common lifts, pumps & lighting
CCTV coverage for common areas at entry/exit points

locationInfo.summary: Located in Whitefield off Borewell Road, close to Whitefield Main Road, with easy access to Nexus Whitefield, Brigade Cosmopolis and Manipal Hospital.
